newsitem.title: INDIA: Bank of America cuts Indian prime rate to 17.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of America cuts Indian prime rate to 17.5 pct.

text.p: Bank of America said on Saturday it has decided to cut its Indian prime lending rate to 17.5 percent from 18.25 percent with effect from November 1.
A bank official said its maximum spread over the prime rate would be 3.5 percentage points.

Several banks have cut their prime rate this week after the central bank boosted banks' liquidity by reducing the cash reserve ratio requirement and lowered the interest ceiling on short-term deposits in its six monthly monetary policy on October 19.
